snippet.title: NEVER A PENALTY - Official Trailer | You send the proof
snippet.description:
NEVER A PENALTY is out now on PC (Microsoft Store). A pixel-art football referee simulator: review the VAR replays, look, measure, decide. Eight endings.

You don't blow the whistle. You send the proof. From the review room you check cameras, a magnifier and offside lines, and you uphold or switch every call, while a phone buzzes with envelopes. Eight endings, from the Copa Orbe to prison.

Microsoft Store, Windows (7.99 EUR): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9nj0516716fd
